description: This file defines a PageLoader class responsible for loading and managing page components, route data, and manifests in a Next.js application. It includes methods for fetching page lists, generating data URLs, and preloading routes.

classes.name: PageLoader
classes.description: A class responsible for loading page components, managing route manifests, and generating data URLs in a Next.js environment.

methods.name: normalizeRoute
methods.description: Normalizes a route string by ensuring it starts with '/' and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: getPageList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of pages, either from the build manifest in production or from development manifests.

methods.name: getDataHref
methods.description: Generates a data URL for a page, considering dynamic routes and locale.

methods.name: _isSsg
methods.description: Checks if a route is statically generated by consulting the SSG manifest.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a page component and associated data, returning a cache object.

methods.name: prefetch
methods.description: Preloads route data for faster navigation.
